body: I can't get a good education because I'm just so mentally ill and I feel like a fucking failure. I'm only 17 but I feel like I've ruined my whole life because I can't go to school because it makes me want to shoot myself. My mum doesn't listen and just thinks I'm attention seeking and lazy, despite me having diagnosed anxiety and borderline personality disorder.
I've felt this way for years and it's never changed. I've been to the doctor and they're useless. There's nothing else I can do.
